items.title: Rumah 3 Lantai Terbakar di Penjaringan Jakut, Diduga karena Masalah Listrik
items.summary: Kebakaran melanda rumah tiga lantai di Jalan Sukarela, Jakarta Utara, diduga akibat masalah listrik. Tidak ada korban jiwa, api berhasil dipadamkan.
items.titleEn: Three-story house burned down in a prosecutor's office, suspected of electrical problems
items.summaryEn: The fire struck a three-story house on Sukarela Road, North Jakarta, allegedly due to electrical problems. No fatalities, the fire was extinguished.

items.title: Bawa Mobil dalam Kondisi Mabuk di Jepang, Kapten Angkatan Udara AS Ditangkap

items.titleEn: Drunk driving in Japan, U.S. Air Force Captain Arrested

items.title: Gempa M 4,6 Terjadi di Pulau Karatung Sulut
